name: Rubik's x Marvel Cubers 3x3 (Hulk)
description: Hulk smash your collection with this amazing Hulk 3x3. It comes with a transparent purple stand that attaches to the "body" of your Hulk figure. The head is a standard 3x3, but it may be a little more difficult that your standard cube. This one has centers that you'll have to orient to completely solve. Give it a try and find your inner hero!
